slices.title: Thread-scope workspace sync in execution-core (flag off)
slices.summary: Adds the thread scope to execution-core: ensure_thread_lease (cached in StateStore by run_id, zdr false) and a workspace_sync module whose open hydrates the thread files into a fresh directory behind a Drop guard and whose commit uploads changes and deletions, reports conflicts and never overwrites them. The exclusion predicate skips the program file, scratch, .tmp, .mplconfig, __pycache__, attachments/ and files over 8 MiB. The runtime loop gets a thread branch that reports a workspace result, and ExecuteStepRequest.thread_id = 13 is used only for the workspace and never forwarded to memory tools. Per Appendix B K3-13 the workspace result also reports workspace.redacted_paths[]. Off by default; refused under ZDR with feature sandbox_workspace.

slices.title: Guards: expiry and failure auto-pause, renewal
slices.summary: Adds sweeper guards for schedules that carry a contract: auto-pause on an expired contract (paused_expired) and after three consecutive failed fires (paused_failures), sweep of legacy pending fires older than one hour to unknown, refusal of a bare re-enable of an expired schedule, and a Renew approval path in the panel; each pause emits the S7 outcome.
